children: Coforge, LIC, Adani Green Energy and Meesho are among the stocks in focus ahead of the MSCI November index review, with Nuvama Alternative & Quantitative Research expecting the four companies to be potential additions. The announcement is scheduled for November 12, while the revised index constituents will become effective from November 30.

The proposed changes could trigger significant passive fund flows into the stocks expected to enter the index. Coforge is estimated to attract the highest inflows of $653 million, followed by Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) at $498 million, Adani Green Energy at $300 million and Meesho at $254 million, according to Nuvama.

The estimated inflows could be substantial relative to the stocks’ average daily trading volumes (ADV). The potential inflow into Coforge is equivalent to 11 times its ADV, while the corresponding estimates stand at 16 times for LIC, 12 times for Adani Green Energy and six times for Meesho.
On the other hand, ICICI Life and PI Industries are among the stocks that Nuvama expects could be removed from the MSCI index in the November review.

According to the brokerage estimates, ICICI Life could witness outflows of $145 million, equivalent to 19 times its ADV. PI Industries is estimated to see outflows of $118 million, or seven times its average daily trading volume.

MSCI index revisions are closely tracked by market participants as passive funds benchmarked to these indices adjust their portfolios in line with changes in constituent stocks. Such adjustments can influence foreign portfolio investor flows.
In the August 2026 review, Laurus Labs, Lenskart, Adani Energy Solutions and Groww entered the MSCI Standard Index. Balkrishna Industries, SBI Cards and Astral were excluded from the index.

title: MSCI November rejig: Coforge, LIC, Adani Green and Meesho stocks likely to be added
